title: film.json — the GSAP render contract
description: The composition the render consumer (tools/build.py → render.mjs/assemble.mjs) turns into the seekable GSAP film. Emitted by assemble-board (board lane) and build-scene/assemble (scene lane). The contract is DELIBERATELY flexible and method-dependent, so this schema is permissive: `additionalProperties` is open and only the always-present keys are required — it documents the known keys and their shapes, it does not lock the set. Times are seconds (12.4) OR a voiceover-word anchor ("Save" = first spoken, "Save#2" = second). A full real example lives under server/data/artifacts/<node>/.../film.json; example.json here is a compact valid board.

font.description: CSS font-family name (the moodboard's sourced face).

fontCss.description: file:// (or http) URL to the @font-face stylesheet staging that face.

camera.description: The camera tour: one entry per beat/move, in playback order. The board lane's primary composition key.

plate.description: Plate id/key this beat shows (resolves to plates.<id> or a capture).

target.description: Focal point: [x,y] in plate space, or a selector string the build centres on.

zoom.description: Scale at this beat (1.0 = fit). Scale the focal element to dominate the safe area.

at.description: When this move starts: seconds (number) or a VO-word anchor (string).

plates.description: Map of plate id -> {file, url, steps[]} — the HTML plates the camera references. Scene-lane composites key frames here.

audio.description: The mix: voice / music / sfx tracks + levels. assemble-board maps the storyboard's SOUND/SFX cues here (a <sound>@<anchor> cue -> an sfx entry); free text never reaches the render.

music.description: Music bed: source/file + gain (below 0 dB, ducked under the voice).

sfx.description: Deliberate hits: {sound from click·tick·pop·hit·whoosh·swish, at: VO-word|seconds, gain}.

script.description: The VO lines, in order — the anchor source for word-timed `at` values.

layers.description: Overlay layers composited on top of the plates (chips, captions, character layers).

outro.description: End card: {at} when it starts (the film ends on the last meaningful beat, no dead tail).

captions.description: Caption config: false/absent = off; true | "karaoke" | "block" opts in (tools/captions.py reads it, gated).

capture.description: Real-UI capture context: {width, base (plate dir URL), clean}.

scene.description: Scene-lane metadata (index/of/name/method/master_in/master_out/continues_from/note) when this film.json is one scene of the unified pipeline.
